channel.title: Reranker news — reranker.uk
channel.description: Releases, price changes and retirements from reranker vendors, each sourced to the vendor's own page.

item.title: 11 Nov 2026 — sentence-transformers 6.3.0
item.description: sentence-transformers 6.3.0 is out; it is mostly multi-vector training, and this site's CrossEncoder and ColBERT examples run on it unchanged.

item.title: 5 Nov 2026 — Cohere prices Model Vault by the GPU
item.description: Cohere now prices Model Vault per GPU per hour instead of per model. Pay-as-you-go Rerank 5 prices are unchanged.

item.title: 3 Nov 2026 — Pinecone deprecates pinecone-rerank-v0
item.description: Pinecone marks its own pinecone-rerank-v0 as deprecated: still served, not for new projects, no shutdown date.

item.title: 30 Oct 2026 — Pinecone halves a limit on cohere-rerank-4-fast
item.description: cohere-rerank-4-fast on Pinecone now takes half as many tokens per document as before.

item.title: 29 Oct 2026 — Nemotron-3.5-Rerank-8B becomes a NIM
item.description: NVIDIA NIM 2.4 serves Nemotron-3.5-Rerank-8B as the nemotron-rerank container.

item.title: 28 Oct 2026 — Hindsight releases hs-rerank-1
item.description: Hindsight's hs-rerank-1 is a 114M multilingual cross-encoder under the MIT licence, with an ONNX build for CPUs and no published scores yet.

item.title: 21 Oct 2026 — Cohere releases Rerank 5
item.description: Cohere Rerank 5: Pro and Fast models with calibrated scores and Context Focus, priced per token instead of per search.

item.title: 20 Oct 2026 — NVIDIA releases Nemotron-3.5-Rerank-8B
item.description: NVIDIA's Nemotron-3.5-Rerank-8B scores text, page images or both, under a licence that allows commercial use.

item.title: 30 Sep 2026 — Voyage releases rerank-3
item.description: Voyage rerank-3 is a drop-in upgrade from rerank-2.5 at the same price, with the largest gains on long documents.
